composition.serve_who: Sheet 12 of 196D5023 (BAE Systems Controls harness/wiring series) shows two nearly identical wiring blocks — BEL1-S (top, chain segment S3) and BEL2-S (bottom, chain segment S4) — each terminating a chain cable into a BEL connector (RTN1), a SYNC twisted-pair connector, and a CAN-A connector (Shield/HI/LO). The "BEL" label here is a connector-pin designation on the BEL (Inverter) unit's own I/O harness, not a separate device — these are the CAN-bus/sync/battery-return pigtails for BEL1-S and BEL2-S (STBD BELs), which the register already carries as 629-bel1-s and 629-bel2-s. Per established facts these are the STBD BEL converters (600V DC/230V AC), so this sheet's wiring content attaches to those two device nodes; the shared CAN-bus/backbone concept itself would sit on the 629-bel infrastructure node.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: BEL1-S (STBD BEL-1 converter, chain segment S3)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Terminal strip labeled BEL1-S feeds a BEL connector (pin RTN1), SYNC connector, and CAN-A connector for chain segment S3; established fact identifies BEL1-S as the STBD BEL-1 converter (600V DC/230V AC).

functions.label: S3 chain harness — BEL/SYNC/CAN-A pinout for BEL1-S
functions.what_it_does: Carries the battery return, frequency-select, sync, address/enable, CAN bus, and chain supply/output signals between the BEL1-S terminal strip and the BEL/SYNC/CAN-A connector group for daisy-chain segment S3.
key_components: CAN-A connector Shield/HI/LO (dashed-oval splice/drain point on Shield and LO run)

flow_scenarios.path: BEL1-S terminal strip pin7 (G3-S3R1 VBATTERY RTN) → crossed twisted pair → BEL connector pin RTN1 (also labeled G3-S3R1 SYNC_RTN at SYNC connector); pin2 (G3-S3S1 FREQ_SELECT), pin3 (G3-S3S2 SYNC) → SYNC connector pins 10/3 (crossed); pin11 (G3-S321 CHAIN_OUTPUT) and pin10 (G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY) route to chain cable off-sheet; pin5/6 (CANA_HI/LO) and shield → CAN-A connector Shield/HI/LO via crossed pair with dashed-oval splice/drain on Shield+LO run
pin1 (G3-S329 ENABLE), pin8 (G3-S300a ADR_0), pin9 (G3-S300b ADR_1), and CANA_Shield pin — all marked N/C, not populated on this segment

functions.dry_data: Point-to-point wiring harness, no protective devices/breakers shown; 12-pin I/O terminal strip BEL1-S; twisted-pair sync and CAN-A pairs with crossover (X) splice symbols and one dashed-oval shield/drain termination on CAN-A run.

infrastructure.system_name: BEL CAN bus / SYNC daisy-chain backbone (629-bel)
facts: Sheet shows two chain segments (S3 feeding BEL1-S, S4 feeding BEL2-S) of the shared BEL CAN-A/SYNC daisy-chain infrastructure.
No protective devices (fuses/breakers) shown on this sheet for either segment; consistent with established CBx4/CBx11 BEL CAN bus isolator/SYNC facts residing elsewhere on the BEL system node.
Chain topology: each segment's CHAIN_OUTPUT/CHAIN_SUPPLY pins (11/10) exit off-sheet to continue the daisy-chain to the next segment — continuation not shown on this sheet.
